plugins.name: 10x-engineer
plugins.description: DaoBrew's curated engineering workflow toolkit for Claude Code — brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development, code review, and verification skills for autonomous multi-hour development sessions.

plugins.name: codex-loop-engineering
plugins.description: Repo-first Codex loop execution, handoff, tracker, and verified continuation management for long-running work across projects.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Native Hybrid mission control for Claude Code and Codex — Fable plans and reviews while visible Codex tasks implement a guarded approved DAG.

plugins.name: project-planner
plugins.description: DaoBrew's multi-phase project planning and execution framework for Claude Code. Generates detailed, task-level implementation plans from a master plan, tracks phase status, and executes plans task-by-task with build verification, parallel execution, and checkpoint-based progress tracking.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Advanced multi-agent research system for large codebases and infrastructure — team-based orchestration, a fail-closed Trust Gate (>=95% machine-verified claims), and one canonical mobile-first HTML report delivered through OpenAI Sites.

plugins.name: finding-your-unknowns
plugins.description: Surfaces and classifies task unknowns before and during non-trivial coding work — maps known knowns / known unknowns / unknown knowns / unknown unknowns, with ranked hypotheses, decisive discriminators, and loop-handoff integration.

plugins.name: restyle-ceramic-product-photo
plugins.description: Apply a reproducible soft studio treatment to ceramic product photos — neutral gray backdrop, soft key light, preserved glaze detail, adaptive segmentation, and depth of field for consistent catalog or Instagram looks.

plugins.name: daobrew-video
plugins.description: Apply DaoBrew's video editing house style to HyperFrames compositions — script-sourced captions, readable semi-transparent overlays, soft-blended PiP panels, and the DaoBrew amber + Plus Jakarta Sans outro card. Ships verbatim templates, brand tokens, and fonts.

plugins.name: bazi-reader
plugins.description: Generates a personalized Bazi (Chinese Four Pillars) reading from a birth datetime, including current monthly pillar (流月) interactions, with deterministic pillar computation scripts — never LLM arithmetic — plus red-flag validation tests.

plugins.name: design-language-translator
plugins.description: Translates plain-language design intentions into professional designer vocabulary (matching input language), with 2-3 alternative phrasings per complaint; when an image is attached, also runs an independent design audit flagging 1-3 high-impact issues.

plugins.name: renhua
plugins.description: Edits Chinese AI and technical writing into direct public prose while preserving the author's judgment, facts, technical details, and lived experience.
